label: Header 1 (snap-male)
description: Header 1 Standard 1-pin 0.1 header. Use with straight break away headers (SKU : PRT-00116), right angle break away headers (PRT-00553), swiss pins (PRT-00743), machine pins (PRT-00117), and female headers (PRT-00115).
